subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given triad of numbers.

2312 - 62 - 12
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

2312 - 62 - 12

(2 × 3) (1 × 2) → 62 = 62 (LHS = RHS)

(6 × 2) → 12 = 12 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) 5116 - 56 - 30

(5 × 1) (1 × 6) → **56 = 56 (LHS = RHS)**

(5 × 6) → **30 = 30 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 2) 2423 - 6 - 14

(2 × 4) (2 × 3) → 86 ≠ 6 (LHS ≠ RHS)

(8 × 6) → 48 ≠ 14 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3)3214 - 64 - 26

(3 × 2) (1 × 4) → 64 = 64 (LHS = RHS)

(6 × 4) → 24 ≠ 26 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) 1831 - 83 - 38

(1 × 8) (3 × 1) → 83 ≠ 38 (LHS ≠ RHS)

(8 × 3) → 24 ≠ 38 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options, '5116 - 56 - 30' follows the same logic given.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
